description: This file defines the 'Indirect' class, which implements the INDIRECT function for spreadsheet calculations in PHP. It contains methods for parsing cell addresses, handling ranges, and evaluating references dynamically within a spreadsheet context.

classes.name: Indirect
classes.description: Provides functionality to evaluate INDIRECT references within a spreadsheet, dynamically fetching cell or range values based on string references.

methods.name: a1Format
methods.description: Determines if a cell address is in A1 format or R1C1 format based on the input value.

methods.name: validateAddress
methods.description: Converts a cell address to a string and verifies that it is not empty or null.

methods.name: INDIRECT
methods.description: Main method implementing the INDIRECT spreadsheet function, returning a reference based on a string address.

methods.name: extractRequiredCells
methods.description: Extracts cell values from a range within a worksheet.

methods.name: handleRowColumnRanges
methods.description: Generates a cell range string based on start and end rows/columns, handling relative references.
